title: Toni Craig and Eddie Sereno
summary: Callender gives Toni's maiden name and describes Sereno, her bandleader in Hawaii.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You said back in Honolulu was where you met your first wife, Toni. You said Toni was singing there at the time with Eddie Sereno?

He was a drummer of Hawaiian and Portuguese extraction, and he had a band, and he used to play all the officers' clubs -- and he did quite well. Then later he and his wife opened their own club, and we sort of lost touch.
